text:
Jen Park: Heads up10min sync1 we need to finalize the cloud marketplace intake for AWS/GCP/Azure + note the SI partner integration (CloudScale) and the on-prem appliance image pack. Biggest open: final EULA link, hero screenshot set, AMI + GCP image (x86 + arm64), Azure managed image references, SKU rows, trial entitlement caps, and an SI contact for joint listing. Who picks what?

Diego Ramos: I can own the images and the SI validation artifact. I need the CloudScale test key and the appliance OVA. Can we confirm the required marketplace acceptance tests? Usually they ask for `/health` and a `validation.txt` under `/etc`.

Priya Singh: Legal: we need signed logo release from marketing and the EULA PDF (finalized). Also confirm incident escalation contact (email + phone). For SI co-sell blurb, legal wants the relationship language: "listed with integration partners" vs "joint offering". Which is it?

Liam O'Connor: Product: this is a "listed with integration partner" not a joint legal product. We'll include an integration note but not change contractual terms. SKU plan: RedwoodInference-API (hosted), RedwoodInference-Dedicated, RedwoodInference-Appliance. Trial: 30d with 50k token cap and 10 rps. Confirm?

Jen Park: Good distinction Liam. Diego: publisher IDs for staging: AWS 222333444555, GCP project redwood-market-stage, Azure publisher redwood-partner-stage. Diego, add cloud-init that drops `/etc/marketplace-validation` with the hash. Example: `echo -n "rsw-validate-1977" > /etc/marketplace-validation`

Diego Ramos: Copy. Will build AMIs for eu-west-1 and us-west-2, include arm64 images and the OVA for appliance. ETA: AMIs Thu EOD, OVA Fri AM. Will post IDs + checksums.

Priya Singh: Wording for SI: "Redwood Inference is listed on [Cloud Marketplaces]. Integration with CloudScale enables streamlined on-prem deployments and managed appliances. Consult your CloudScale representative for joint support plans." Legal ok?

Liam O'Connor: That reads fine. Add: "Support: Redwood handles product issues; CloudScale handles appliance deployment and infra support."

Priya Singh: OK to add that line. Also adding KMS line: "Customer-managed keys supported for Dedicated, Private, and Appliance; hosted products use Redwood-managed keys by default."

Jen Park: Great. MarketplaceBot: please create intake ticket and link vendor onboarding doc.

MarketplaceBot: Created ticket MP-4999: "marketplace intake - redwood inference (CloudScale)" assigned partnerships. https://tickets.redwood.example/MP-4999

Diego Ramos: One ops note: Azure wants a VM image reference and a managed image resource id, not just an OVA. I'll request infra to publish a managed image in the staging subscription.

Liam O'Connor: For pricing rows we need hourly list price + monthly commit tiers and trial redemption SKU. I'll draft the pricing table and post it to the intake doc.

Priya Singh: I'll upload EULA and logo release PDFs to the ticket once marketing signs. Also will draft short privacy snippet: no PII telemetry, retention 90 days aggregate metrics.

Jen Park: Action list: Diego = build images + publish IDs/checksums, Liam = pricing rows + quotas, Priya = EULA + SI language + privacy, Jen = hero screenshots + open partner contact for CloudScale. Target: submit to portals Mon COB.

Diego Ramos: +1, posting progress here when images are live.

Liam O'Connor: +, will have pricing draft by Fri.

Priya Singh: +, will share legal artifacts today.

Jen Park: Thanks team. If anyone spots a marketplace-specific gotcha (license fields, trial checkout flow), ping me directly.
